g.text: RF-CAS-v1 OPERATOR TRAINING SIMULATOR · REV 0 ISSUED FOR TEACHING
DEMETHANIZER FEED CHILLING · C3= / C2= CASCADE REFRIGERATION
1. Flows t/h, temperatures °C, pressures bar a: design point of the simulator model (noise off), not plant data.
2. Rev 0, issued for teaching. Refrigerant liquid flashes across LV-103 / LV-213 / LV-108; recycles 17 and 24 closed at design.
3. K-201 and K-301 are steam-turbine driven; only the valves that define the process are shown.
